platform.name: UMYU Scholar
platform.description: A digital repository and academic social platform for Umaru Musa Yar'adua University, Katsina.
platform.purpose: To preserve, share, and promote academic research from the UMYU community.
platform.creator: Ismail Habib Ismail
platform.project_type: A campus benefit project to help UMYU students and staff share research.

authentication.signup: Go to auth.html. Use your @umyu.edu.ng (staff) or @students.umyu.edu.ng (student) email. You'll receive a verification email. Click the link to verify.
authentication.login: Go to auth.html. Enter your UMYU email and password.
authentication.logout: Click the 'Logout' button at the bottom of the left sidebar.
authentication.forgot_password: On auth.html, click 'Forgot password?'. Enter your email to receive a reset link.
authentication.email_verification: Check your inbox and spam folder. Click the verification link to activate your account.
authentication.why_verify: Email verification is required to upload papers and access all features. It confirms you are a real UMYU student or staff.
authentication.email_domains: Students use @students.umyu.edu.ng. Staff use @umyu.edu.ng. Both are accepted.

upload.who_can_upload: Only UMYU students and staff with verified emails can upload.
upload.how_to: 1. Sign in. 2. Go to upload.html. 3. Fill in all required fields: Title, Authors, Department, Year, Keywords, Abstract, Author Contact. 4. Upload PDF (max 10MB). 5. Optionally upload software (ZIP/RAR/7z, max 50MB). 6. Click 'Upload Paper'.
upload.file_types: PDF required (max 10MB). ZIP, RAR, 7z optional for software (max 50MB).
upload.multiple_authors: Click 'Add Author' to include co-authors. At least one author is required.
upload.abstract_requirements: Abstract must be between 150 and 500 words.
upload.contact_info: Provide an email or phone number so readers can contact you.
upload.troubleshooting: If your upload doesn't appear: check email verification, use UMYU email, fill all required fields, ensure PDF is under 10MB.

download.how_to: Browse papers on the homepage or use search. Click the download button (⬇️) on paper cards or on the paper detail page.
download.free: All papers are free to download for research and personal use. No account needed to download.
download.software: If a paper has software, look for the 'Software' badge. Click 'Download Software' to get the archive.
download.citation: You must properly cite any papers you use in your own work.

interactions.like: Click the ❤️ icon on any paper. Requires login.
interactions.unlike: Click the ❤️ icon again to remove your like.
interactions.bookmark: Click the ⭐ icon to save papers to your library. Requires login.
interactions.remove_bookmark: Click the ⭐ icon again or go to library.html and click 'Remove'.
interactions.library: Access all bookmarked papers at library.html.

profile.view: Go to profile.html to see your uploaded papers and statistics.
profile.delete_paper: Go to profile.html, find your paper, click 'Delete'. Confirm to delete.
profile.stats: Your profile shows total papers and how many have software.
profile.delete_account: Contact support at contact.html or email umyuscholar@gmail.com to request account deletion.

search.how_to: Use the search bar on the homepage to search by title, author name, or department.
search.filters: Use the filter icon (⚙️) next to the search bar to filter by year.
search.browse: Scroll down on the homepage to see the latest uploads. Click 'Load More' to see more papers.

support.contact_page: Go to contact.html to send a message.
support.response_time: We respond within 24-48 hours during business days.
support.faq: Visit support.html for frequently asked questions.

legal.privacy_policy: The Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your data. Read it at privacy.html.
legal.privacy_summary: We collect your name, email, uploaded content, and interaction data. We use it to provide and improve the platform. We never sell your data.
legal.terms_of_use: The Terms of Use define the rules for using UMYU Scholar. Read them at terms.html.
legal.terms_summary: You must be 18 or older. You retain copyright of your work. You agree not to upload plagiarized or copyrighted content. Accounts violating terms may be terminated.

general.what_is: UMYU Scholar is a digital repository where UMYU students and staff can share academic papers, research projects, theses, and software source code.
general.who_can_upload: Only UMYU students and staff with verified @umyu.edu.ng or @students.umyu.edu.ng emails can upload.
general.who_can_download: Anyone can browse and download papers for free. No account needed.
general.why_use: Share your research, build your academic portfolio, get cited, help future UMYU students.
general.software_projects: If your research includes software, you can upload a ZIP/RAR/7z file with your paper.
